heading: INT. HOLLOWAY & DRAKE, OPEN-PLAN FLOOR, "SYNERGY POD" - DAY

units.text: INT. HOLLOWAY & DRAKE, OPEN-PLAN FLOOR, "SYNERGY POD" - DAY
A glass cube in the middle of forty identical desks.
Beanbags.
A whiteboard reading "WINS!!" in six colors.
A mini-fridge hums with kombucha.
BRENT STOLLER, thirties, vest over a Henley, paces in front of the board holding a ceremonial marker.
DEIRDRE KOH, forties, brisk, with a pen behind each ear, sits cross-legged on a beanbag.
QUINCY ABARA, twenties, the junior analyst, perches on the edge of a stool, holding a laptop like a shield.
Team, great energy. I just want to say, we are crushing Q3.
units.name: BRENT

units.text: We missed Q3.
units.name: DEIRDRE

units.text: We pre-crushed it. In spirit.
units.name: BRENT

units.text: Quincy scribbles.
Deirdre catches her eye and mouths something.
She mouths it back.
Neither smiles.
Brent, should I put "pre-crushed" in the deck?
units.name: QUINCY

units.text: Absolutely. Bold it.
units.name: BRENT

units.text: She does.
The fridge hums.
Everything seems fine.
The glass door slides open.
AUGUSTINE VANCE-PELL, sixty, chief executive, silver and enormous in a camel coat, enters with a binder under one arm and a wide, serene smile.
Brent's marker stops moving.
Deirdre rises from the beanbag in one smooth motion, like someone leaving a bomb site.
Quincy shuts her laptop.
Please. Don't stop on my account.
units.name: AUGUSTINE

units.text: He walks to the whiteboard and reads it, lips moving.
Then he turns, and the smile has not changed at all.
I have a very short announcement. Who would like to hear it?
units.name: AUGUSTINE

units.text: Nobody speaks.
Deirdre raises her hand, as if at school.
